To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) MCSs have distinct and identifiable life cycles that are characterized by a number of different stages; (2) the evolution of MCSs is governed by a number of processes that are related to the large-scale forcing and the internal dynamics of the MCS; and (3) the evolution of the MCSs can be predicted with some skill using a combination of large-scale forcing data, the current MCS position and structure, and a knowledge of how MCSs evolve in response to large-scale forcing.
